blocks.text:
You can cast `RefPtr`s to base types, just like normal
pointers.
blocks.zh: 你可以像对正常指针进行类型转换一样，将RefPtr转换到基础类型。

blocks.text:
auto refStore = Gtk::TreeStore::create(columns);
Glib::RefPtr<Gtk::TreeModel> refModel = refStore;

This means that any method which takes a `const
Glib::RefPtr&` argument can also take a
`const Glib::RefPtr&`. The cast is
implicit, just as it would be for a normal pointer.
blocks.zh: 这意味着任何接受const Glib::RefPtr&参数的函数也能接受const Glib::RefPtr&对象。此转换和普通指针一样是隐式的。

blocks.text:
You can also cast to a derived type, but the syntax is
a little different than with a normal pointer.
blocks.zh: 你还可以将其转换为派生类型，但是语法和普通指针的语法略有不同。
